trans-unit.source: Environment names must contain 1-80 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores, start with a letter or digit, and must not be Windows reserved device names.
trans-unit.target: Имена сред должны содержать от 1 до 80 ASCII-символов: букв, цифр, дефисов или символов подчеркивания. Имя должно начинаться с буквы или цифры и не должно совпадать с зарезервированным именем устройства Windows.

trans-unit.source: Secrets file '{0}' contains invalid JSON (line {1}, byte position {2}). Fix the JSON in this file and try again. In JSON strings, escape a backslash as '\\' (for example, 'server\\sql').
trans-unit.target: Secrets file '{0}' contains invalid JSON (line {1}, byte position {2}). Fix the JSON in this file and try again. In JSON strings, escape a backslash as '\\' (for example, 'server\\sql').
trans-unit.note: {0} is the secrets file path. {1} and {2} are the one-based line number and byte position. Backslashes in the JSON examples must remain doubled.
